summary: This bill designates new wilderness areas, wild and scenic rivers, and special management areas in Northern California, establishes a restoration area and a partnership for land remediation, and directs studies and plans for recreation and conservation on federal lands.

scores.thoughts: This bill is primarily focused on environmental protection and conservation in Northern California. It designates new wilderness areas, wild and scenic rivers, and special management areas, all of which aim to protect and restore natural ecosystems, aquatic habitats, and wildlife. It also includes provisions for forest restoration and fire management plans that emphasize ecological integrity and the use of prescribed fire and shaded fuel breaks to reduce wildfire threats, which are positive environmental actions. The establishment of a remediation partnership to address damage from illegal activities further supports environmental protection.
